acceptance: A key version is retired only when every registered holder of sealed data is clear of it and no tenant writes under it; adopting a tenant's keys merges every imported version or none; multi-process limits are recorded.

positive.fixture: retirement after rewrap; adoption keeps tenant-rotated versions; vault secrets keep their key alive

negative.fixture: retire with data under the key, with no holder, with a failing holder, with a tenant writing under it; conflicting import merges nothing

security_and_source_permissions: Retirement fails closed; no plaintext or plaintext hash crosses tenants.
performance_memory_storage: Retirement scans every private object once.
known_limitations: Keyring files are not safe to share between processes
Bundles and caches are not yet registered holders; caches are disposable
